P33-n-queens:
def solve_n_queens(n):
    cols, diag, anti = set(), set(), set()   # c, r - c, r + c
    board = [['.'] * n for _ in range(n)]
    res = []

    def dfs(r):
        if r == n:
            res.append([''.join(row) for row in board])
            return
        for c in range(n):
            if c in cols or r - c in diag or r + c in anti:
                continue
            cols.add(c)
            diag.add(r - c)
            anti.add(r + c)
            board[r][c] = 'Q'
            dfs(r + 1)
            cols.remove(c)
            diag.remove(r - c)
            anti.remove(r + c)
            board[r][c] = '.'

    dfs(0)
    return res
